description: Figure 7 presents the number of questions, out of 40, containing at least one factual error when chain-of-thought reasoning was generated by GPT3 using different methods. The horizontal axis represents the method used, labeled as “2W-HQ”, “2W-MW”, “2W-LW”, “HQ”, “MW”, and “LW”, and the categories are ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of questions with factual error” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  There are six bars representing each method, with each bar split into three colored sections: red for “OneR”, blue for “NoR”, and green for “IRCoT”. The red “OneR” section consistently shows the lowest values across all methods, with values ranging from approximately 4.6 for “2W-HQ” to 8.2 for “LW”. The blue “NoR” sections are generally taller, ranging from approximately 6.4 for “2W-HQ” to 14.8 for “LW”. The green “IRCoT” sections are the tallest, ranging from approximately 10.6 for “2W-HQ” to 26.8 for “LW”.  The bars are not visually emphasized in any particular way. The figure includes a note stating that factual errors are less frequent with “OneR” than with “NoR”.
